newsitem.title: USA: Three killed in Washington coffee shop.
newsitem.headline: Three killed in Washington coffee shop.

text.p: Three employes of a Starbucks coffee shop in Washington's posh Georgetown area were found shot to death Monday, according to a television news report here.
Two men and a woman, all with gunshot wounds to the head, were discovered in a back room about 5 a.m. EDT by an employee coming to work, WRC-TV reported.
The victims were not identified and no further details were available.
